箱式货车

A rail freight wagon with a fully enclosed structure, used for transporting weather-sensitive general cargo; referenced in rail waybills and UIC documentation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 箱式货车?

In this glossary, 箱式货车 refers to: A rail freight wagon with a fully enclosed structure, used for transporting weather-sensitive general cargo; referenced in rail waybills and UIC documentation.

How is 箱式货车 used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "箱式货车装载了消费品用于铁路运输，并记录在铁路运单中。"

Why does 箱式货车 matter in logistics?

箱式货车 matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses 箱式货车?

箱式货车 is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?
